provides: Given an admissible m-row batch algorithm with worst-case expected NEW-query bill C, start from the ACTUAL single distinguished old X~P and acquire m-1 NEW independent P records. Uniformly permute all m rows, run the batch algorithm, undo the permutation and return the original distinguished row output. The input remains IID for every fixed permutation; the exact whole output Q^m gives the selected exact marginal Q. Exchangeability and random symmetrization make designated-row expected mismatch equal the batch-average guarantee. The m-1 added P calls and expected finite exact-permutation bit work are CHARGED, so a valid one-old-sample coupler costs at most m-1+C. Therefore C*(d,m,eta)>=C*(d,1,eta)-(m-1). Combine with the pointwise target floor to get max{m,C*(d,1,eta)-m+1}. The accepted tolerant-testing lower bound transfers only with this SUBTRACTION and its original small-eta regimes/constants; it cannot be multiplied by m or treated as a matched all-regime rate.

ROOT THEOREM in the exact P1 batch model (fresh P/Q samples, actual X~P^m, exact ENTIRE Y~Q^m, unknown fixed laws, finite fair-bit computation/a.s. halting): EVERY universal exact-output algorithm has E_(P,Q)N_Q>=m for every fixed P,Q. No retention guarantee, deterministic cap, atom floor or exponential moment is needed for this lower bound. If mean is infinite the statement is immediate; otherwise:
Choose any full-support Q' != Q while keeping P, d,m,eta and the PROGRAM fixed. The countable stopped transcript T includes actual old rows, all adaptively selected P/Q replies and used fair bits. For any finite transcript possible under Q, its likelihood ratio against Q' is the product of q(Z)/q'(Z) over exactly its Q replies. P replies/old P^m/fair-bit factors cancel. The finite-alphabet log ratios on supp(Q) are bounded for this FIXED pair; finite E N_Q therefore makes their stopped sum integrable. Predictable request indicators and fresh oracle independence give
 D(law_Q T || law_Q' T) = E_Q sum_(Q replies) log[q(Z)/q'(Z)] = (E_Q N_Q) D(Q||Q').
This remains valid when Q has zeros: law_Q T is one-way absolutely continuous with respect to law_Q' T, and the equality only averages Q-positive replies. Q' a.s. halts by universality; no missing nontermination mass. This is a direct stopped-transcript derivation, not an appeal to a theorem requiring mutual absolute continuity at a degenerate Q. Data processing through the actual output gives m D(Q||Q')=D(Q^m||Q'^m)<=D(transcripts). The finite positive divergence cancels. Arbitrarily many extra P queries, old labels/independent stored responses that do not depend on Q and free fair bits cannot evade this target-query floor. No inspection/timing/identity access to the opaque oracle is granted.

COROLLARY: for the released minimax C*(d,m,eta), C*>=m. Combine the ALREADY accepted exact histogram matching for m old IID P rows and exactly m new Q draws:
 E same-row mismatch <= TV(P,Q)+sqrt((d-1)/m).
Therefore when m>=ceil((d-1)/eta²), the exact answer is C*(d,m,eta)=m, attained with N_P=0,N_Q=m deterministically.
